name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down to a comfortable depth with chest up.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Reset your stance between reps if you lose form.
cues: Knees track over toes on landing

common_mistakes.fix: Bend knees and hips to absorb the landing
Land with knees in line with toes
Stop the set when landings get loud
